rationale: WarmupCosineLR.get_lr() returned a scalar rather than a list of length num_param_groups. Detection: single-rank check that len(scheduler.get_lr()) == len(optimizer.param_groups). Layer schema_only: no cross-rank compare and no module-attr precond needed (rule applies to all schedulers uniformly). Borderline value_equality vs completeness (anti-example 12): chose completeness because the invariant is over the set of param-group LRs (cardinality), not a single value matching a constant. Pattern P1 because the trace field 'len(get_lr())' has a deterministic expected value derived from optimizer config.
